<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Stoney Deflection](/Feats.aspx?ID=4373) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 82

**Archetype** [Stone Brawler](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=209)

**Prerequisites**
[Stone Brawler Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4371)

**Requirements**
You are in Stonestrike Stance.

</column>

---

You gather the resiliency of stone to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and to any defenses against being [Shoved](/Actions.aspx?ID=38) or [Tripped](/Actions.aspx?ID=40) until the beginning of your next turn.
name: Stoney Deflection
